We adapt proportional-integral (PI) step-size control to diffusion, using our diffusion noise-normalised error estimator. Unlike existing adaptive methods in diffusion that respond only to the current error, the PI solver also incorporates the previous error, yielding smoother step adaptation. We further show that these per-sample trajectories exhibit shared structure and can be aggregated into a fixed schedule that retains much of the benefit of adaptive sampling. We evaluate both approaches on natural-image and language datasets, in terms of quality, measured by FID at a matched number of neural network evaluations (NFE), comparing them with widely used stochastic solvers and schedules. For images, our fixed discretization outperforms the commonly used EDM schedule in terms of sample quality when used with the stochastic Heun sampler, and with the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Additionally, our PI adaptive solver obtains better FID than most stochastic and adaptive baselines, although it does not beat the EDM-churn sampler at low NFE. Moreover, we find our solver outperforms both the EDM and the entropy schedule on language diffusion at low-to-medium NFE in terms of perplexity, with the drawback of lower token entropy. Lastly, we find that the benefit of per-sample adaptivity is problem-dependent. It is highly beneficial in 1D toy examples, while only marginal for image and language data, where the average schedule sometimes even outperforms the PI-adaptive solver. Code is available at https://github.com/ellakemperman/adaptive-second-order-diffusion-solvers

</details>


### [392] [Efficient Memory Crystallization for Graph Learning under Non-Stationary Distribution Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02795)
*Yue Hou,Ruomei Liu,Yingke Su,Junran Wu,Ke Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练的测试时框架EMC，通过闭式解"结晶"出紧凑记忆图，替代生成式记忆，高效应对图分布持续漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实系统中的深度图学习模型常面临非平稳环境，图分布随时间持续漂移。现有方法依赖训练辅助生成模块合成记忆图进行跨域适应，计算开销大，且在长期分布漂移下扩展性差。作者认为存在更经济的路径：不生成记忆，而是"结晶"记忆。

Method: EMC是一个免训练的测试时框架，将每个到来的图域通过面向记忆的分布匹配目标的闭式解，蒸馏为紧凑且语义忠实的记忆，从而在持续协变量偏移下消除冗余域信息。为进一步保持泛化性与适应性，EMC通过状态演化记忆建模域间依赖，并给出理论上更紧的泛化误差界。

Result: 在非平稳分布漂移的图上，EMC性能优于最先进基线；相比近期竞争方法，平均运行时间减少87.4%，GPU内存消耗减少92.4%。

Conclusion: EMC以"结晶"替代"生成"的思路，实现了免训练、低开销的持续图适应，使大规模图持续适应更具实用性。

Abstract: Deep graph learning models deployed in real-world systems often need to cope with non-stationary environments, where the underlying graph distribution drifts continually over time. Prevailing solutions rely on training auxiliary generative modules to synthesize memory graphs for cross-domain adaptation, which incurs substantial computational overhead and scales poorly under prolonged distribution shifts. We argue that a more economical path exists: rather than generating memory, one can crystallize it. To this end, we propose Efficient Memory Crystallization (EMC), a training-free test-time framework that distills each incoming graph domain into a compact, semantically faithful memory through a closed-form solution to a memory-oriented distribution-matching objective, thereby eliminating redundant domain information under continual covariate shifts. To preserve both generalizability and adaptability as the model traverses a long sequence of target domains, EMC further models inter-domain dependencies through state-evolving memories and admits a theoretically grounded, tighter generalization error bound than direct adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of EMC over state-of-the-art baselines on graphs under non-stationary distribution shifts, while reducing average runtime by 87.4% and GPU memory consumption by 92.4% relative to the recent competitor, making continual graph adaptation practical at scale.

</details>


### [393] [Muon Learns Facts Better: Understanding the Role of Spectral Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02798)
*Xuheng Li,Qiwei Di,Yuan Cao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过可求解的事实回忆模型，本文从机理层面揭示了 Muon 优化器中的谱正交化如何重塑特征学习动态：将梯度流中的特征分离时间比从 √(S/R) 降至常数级，并使误差从多项式衰减变为指数衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 优化器对矩阵更新做谱正交化，在大规模神经网络训练中表现优异，但该变换在特征学习中的机理尚不清晰。作者希望用一个可解析的模型来刻画其特征学习机制。

Method: 构造一个可求解的"事实回忆"模型：事实将主体-关系对映射到答案，线性 Transformer 需学习主体相关与关系相关信息。分别用梯度流（对应梯度下降）、谱梯度流（对应 Muon）和 Sign 梯度流（对应 Adam）优化，定义主体/关系分量的学习时间并分析其比例、误差衰减率与正交变换等变性。

Result: 设 S 个主体、R 个关系，梯度流的学习时间比为 Θ̃(√(S/R))，谱梯度流将其降至 Θ̃(1)；固定 S、R 时，梯度流下误差按 1/(T log T) 衰减，谱梯度流下按 exp(-poly(T)) 衰减。梯度流与谱梯度流对词嵌入的正交变换等变，Sign 梯度流则不等变，不同正交嵌入可能产生无分离、大分离甚至反转的学习顺序。

Conclusion: 谱正交化能够从根本上改变特征学习动态，这为理解 Muon 相对梯度下降与 Adam 的优势提供了机理性的解释。

Abstract: The Muon optimizer applies spectral orthogonalization to matrix-valued updates and has shown strong performance in large-scale neural network training, yet the mechanisms of this transformation in feature learning remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this question through a tractable factual-recall model, where a fact maps each subject-relation pair to an answer, and a linear transformer learns the subject- and relation-dependent information required to recover this mapping. The transformer is optimized with gradient flow (GF), spectral GF, or Sign GF, which are continuous-time limits of gradient descent, Muon, and Adam, respectively. Prior studies (Nichani et al., 2025) have shown that when the number of subjects exceeds the number of relations, GF learns relation-dependent information before subject-dependent information, producing a feature-separation phase during training. We characterize this separation with the learning times when the subject- and relation-dependent components of the prediction reach a target accuracy. With $S$ subjects and $R$ relations, GF has a learning-time ratio of $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{S/R})$, whereas Spectral GF reduces this ratio to $\widetildeΘ(1)$. In addition, for fixed $S$ and $R$, the subject- and relation-dependent errors decay as $1/(T\log T)$ in training time $T$ under GF, but as $\exp(-\mathrm{poly}(T))$ under spectral GF. Finally, we show that GF and spectral GF are equivariant under orthogonal transformations of the token embeddings, whereas Sign GF is not: Different orthonormal embeddings can potentially produce no feature separation, a large feature-separation phase, or even a reversed learning order. These results provide a mechanistic view of how spectral orthogonalization can fundamentally reshape feature-learning dynamics.

</details>


### [394] [Gated Slot Attention-2: Two-Sided Associative Memory Correction in Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02816)
*Ruijie Li,Shengnan Ding,Weimin Zhang,Derick Tang,Zhanpeng Zeng,Qinsong Zeng,Ming Chen,Jiaxi Hu,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gated Oja Rule及其改进版Gated Oja Rule-2，并结合Gated Delta Rule-2构建Gated Slot Attention-2（GSA2），在保持线性时间与常数内存的前提下提升线性注意力模型的记忆管理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力模型虽高效，但其固定大小的循环记忆难以有效管理。已有两条改进路线：delta-rule变体用于精确修正与键关联的值，以及槽式架构（如Gated Slot Attention）分两阶段建模键与值记忆。本文观察到这两条路线具有互补性：delta规则提供有效的记忆修正，两阶段结构为关联的键侧与值侧操作提供自然方式。

Method: 基于上述互补性洞察，提出Gated Oja Rule用于键侧修正，并通过解耦擦除与写入控制扩展为Gated Oja Rule-2。随后提出GSA2，通过共享潜在槽将键侧的Gated Oja Rule-2与值侧的Gated Delta Rule-2相结合。此外，推导出一种硬件高效的chunkwise算法以支持并行训练。

Result: 实验表明，GSA2在多个基准上持续优于强线性注意力基线，同时保持线性时间序列建模与常数内存的循环解码。

Conclusion: 通过对键侧与值侧修正的互补性建模，GSA2在效率与性能之间取得更好平衡，为线性注意力记忆管理提供了新方向。

Abstract: Linear attention models have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard attention, but effectively managing their fixed-size recurrent memory remains challenging. To improve memory, recent work has explored two distinct directions: delta-rule variants for precise correction of values associated with keys, and slot-based architectures such as Gated Slot Attention for modeling key and value memories in two stages. We observe that these directions are complementary--the delta rule provides effective memory correction, while the two-stage structure provides a natural way to operate on both sides of an association. Building on this insight, we introduce a new Gated Oja Rule for key-side correction and extend it with decoupled erase and write control to obtain Gated Oja Rule-2. We then introduce Gated Slot Attention-2 (GSA2), which combines Gated Oja Rule-2 for key-side correction with Gated Delta Rule-2 for value-side correction through shared latent slots. We further derive a hardware-efficient chunkwise algorithm for parallel training. Experiments demonstrate that GSA2 consistently improves over strong linear-attention baselines across benchmarks while retaining linear-time sequence modeling and constant-memory recurrent decoding.

</details>


### [395] [Adaptive Spectral-Koopman Dynamics Modeling for Temporal Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02822)
*Tengxue Zhang,Yu Ke,Yang Shu,Chenchen Sun,Yisheng An,Chenjuan Guo,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaSpecK，一种结合谱正则化Koopman动力学与自适应上下文提取的时序域泛化框架，在八个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实流式数据随时间发生分布偏移，现有时序域泛化方法要么在数据空间过拟合域特定噪声，要么在参数空间中过于复杂且可解释性差。

Method: 一是谱正则化Koopman动力学建模，在潜空间进行谱感知滤波，提取去噪的低频轨迹，并用Koopman算子线性化建模系统动力学以缓解不规则采样域上的噪声拟合；二是上下文感知的异构模式提取机制，用目标条件注意力模块关注不同历史窗口生成动态的目标特定历史摘要，并通过构建环境签名与学习路由器自适应判断哪些过去上下文对预测最有用。

Result: 在八个涵盖分类与回归的多种基准上，AdaSpecK取得了最先进（SOTA）性能。

Conclusion: AdaSpecK通过谱-Koopman框架与自适应上下文提取，有效平衡了噪声鲁棒性与可解释性，验证了其在时序域泛化任务上的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Temporal Domain Generalization (TDG) has emerged to address real-world streaming data with distribution shifts over time. However, existing methods are either prone to overfitting to domain-specific noise in the data space or become overly complex and less interpretable in the parameter space. To bridge these gaps, we propose \textbf{AdaSpecK}, a spectral-Koopman framework with adaptive context extraction for TDG. To mitigate noise fitting to irregularly sampled domains, we introduce spectral-regularized Koopman dynamics modeling, which applies spectral-aware filtering in the latent space to extract denoised low-frequency trajectories and learn a Koopman operator to model the system dynamics in a linearized space. To model complex historical environments under non-stationarity, we design a context-informed heterogeneous pattern extraction mechanism. Specifically, we employ a target-conditioned attention module to attend to distinct past windows, producing a dynamic, target-specific historical summary. By constructing an environmental signature from the current evolutionary pattern, our model adaptively perceives which aspects of the past context are most informative for future prediction via a learned router. Extensive experiments on eight diverse classification and regression benchmarks demonstrate that AdaSpecK achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code and datasets are available at \href{}{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Ada-Spec-K}.

</details>


### [396] [Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03199)
*Jungseob Lee,Seungyoon Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Hyeonseok Moon,Jaehyung Seo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出任务向量干扰度量与合并前评分，预测模型合并坍塌，并给出无需数据与调参的PRISM算子修复坍塌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享基座微调的大模型可通过任务向量平均合并，但部分合并会严重坍塌至基座之下，且现有合并算子评估前无任何预警信号，缺乏可预测性与可控修复手段。

Method: 以专家任务向量跨专家的方差作为干扰度量（等于平均所移除的功率）；在噪声模型下推导合并扰动随合并系数与干扰增长，形成合并前评分。发现符号冲突统计反而不具预测性。提出PRISM：先平均任务向量，再按各层干扰水平对每层做软阈值处理，仅在超过阈值时启用。

Result: 在四个模型家族共二十二种合并配置中，仅破坏性合并超过评分阈值；对十四次合并做事前预测，十二次正确（含持续预训练使某专家对越过阈值的破坏性结果）。PRISM 在无数据、无调参下使全部五次破坏性合并保持在阈值之上，与基座评估噪声相当，而普通平均至少低14.4分或完全坍塌。

Conclusion: 任务向量干扰统计可同时预测并校准合并坍塌；基于干扰的自适应软阈值算子PRISM可作为合并前的预警与修复手段，仅需对超阈值合并启用，安全场景仍用普通平均。

Abstract: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.

</details>


### [397] [All Work And No Play Makes Jack a Dull Boy: Understanding and Preventing Catastrophic Strategy Collapse in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02835)
*Qiyuan Huang,Tianshi Xu,Meng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）后训练中GRPO类算法的后期崩溃现象，提出策略容量收缩的机理理论，并给出MEI预警指标与Mesh Learning方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO类算法在大模型RLVR后训练中会出现严重的后期崩溃。作者通过提示探测发现，这并非良性的策略剪枝，而是有效策略容量的有害收缩，导致不同推理策略越来越难以被访问，因而需要刻画并防止这一现象。

Method: 以轨迹级策略更新交互定义"策略"，结合优化动力学与信息论建立统一理论框架，证明主流RLVR目标会将概率质量逐步集中到单一策略上，而维持任务精度需要最低策略容量；由此推导出Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)作为轻量在线预警信号，并提出Mesh Learning方法，同时暴露多种推理策略、防止单一策略主导优化。

Result: 在AIME26、AIME25、MATH-500、GPQA、LiveCodeBench上，Mesh Learning在Qwen与Phi系列模型上持续优于强基线，最高分别提升13.4个百分点和11.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 策略保持（strategy preservation）是稳定RLVR的关键原则；理论解释了崩溃机理，MEI可在线预警，Mesh Learning能有效缓解崩溃并提升性能。

Abstract: During post-training of large language models (LLMs) with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), GRPO-style algorithms can exhibit severe late-stage collapse. Prompt-based probing reveals that this is not benign strategic pruning, but a harmful contraction of effective strategy capacity that makes distinct reasoning strategies increasingly inaccessible. To characterize this phenomenon, we define strategies through trajectory-level policy-update interactions and develop a unified theoretical framework combining optimization dynamics and information theory. We prove that major RLVR objectives progressively concentrate probability mass onto a single strategy, while sustaining nontrivial task accuracy requires a minimum strategy capacity. The conflict between these two results provides a mechanistic explanation for catastrophic collapse. We further derive the {Mirrored Entanglement Index (MEI)} as a lightweight online warning signal. To prevent collapse, we propose \textbf{Mesh Learning}, which exposes multiple reasoning strategies and prevents any single strategy from dominating optimization. Across AIME26, AIME25, MATH-500, GPQA, and LiveCodeBench, Mesh Learning consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen and Phi model families, with gains of up to 13.4 pp and 11.5 pp, respectively. These results establish strategy preservation as a key principle for stable RLVR. Code is available at https://github.com/Ayanami-0123/Open-Mesh-Learning.

</details>


### [398] [AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03223)
*Xin Wang,Wenhao Wu,Menghao Zhang,Zhi Wang,Kun Shao,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaStep，一种自适应步级信用加权方法，通过均方误差估计推导最优收缩系数，在低计算成本下提升长时程LLM智能体训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程LLM智能体通常仅使用稀疏的结果奖励进行训练，轨迹级目标过于粗糙，无法区分单个决策的贡献。步级信用分配虽能提供更细粒度监督，但由于观测回报还依赖后续动作、环境转移和轨迹长度，其估计往往不可靠。

Method: 将权重设计表述为对潜在步级优势的均方误差估计问题，在显式条件采样假设下推导出最优的逐状态收缩系数。该系数具有信噪比（信号与总方差之比）的解释：当回报变化可归因于所选动作时保留局部信用，当变化由下游随机性主导时则抑制局部信用。方法仅需轻量标量计算，无需critic、额外采样或额外模型推理。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个环境上，使用三种模型骨干进行实验，相较基线取得了一致的性能提升，且计算成本较低。

Conclusion: AdaStep通过自适应的步级信用加权，在保持低计算开销的同时有效改善了长时程LLM智能体的训练效果，为细粒度信用分配提供了一种实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents are typically trained with sparse outcome rewards, making trajectory-level objectives too coarse to distinguish the contribution of individual decisions. Step-level credit assignment provides finer-grained supervision, but its estimates can be unreliable because observed returns also depend on subsequent actions, environment transitions, and trajectory length. We propose AdaStep, an Adaptive Step-credit weighting method that controls how strongly each group-derived local advantage modifies the trajectory-level signal. We formulate this weighting as a mean-squared-error estimation problem for the latent step advantage and, under an explicit conditional sampling assumption, derive an optimal per-state shrinkage coefficient. The coefficient admits a signal-to-total-variance interpretation: it preserves local credit when return variation is attributable to the selected action and suppresses it when variation is dominated by downstream randomness. AdaStep requires only lightweight scalar computation, with no critic, additional rollouts, or extra model inference. Experiments with three model backbones on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld show consistent improvements over baselines at low computational cost.

</details>


### [399] [Understanding Enrichment in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02846)
*Jinwoo Kim,Shraddha Barke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从理论与方法层面分析RLVR中"富集采样（提示/中间引导）"所引入的重要性权重偏差问题，提出基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）的权重校正机制，并在Qwen3-1.7B稀疏数学推理微调上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在奖励稀疏场景下，RLVR常借助提示或中间引导生成更多成功轨迹，但这种"富集"会使策略梯度更新产生偏差，除非用重要性权重校正。现有方法要么忽略校正，要么为避免高方差而截断权重，导致无法明确校正富集轨迹究竟带来何种收益或损失。作者希望系统性地理解富集与校正对训练的影响，而非简单断言哪种方式更优。

Method: 1）数学证明被忽略或截断的校正实际上隐式地重新加权了定义的奖励；2）将由此产生的梯度误差分解为尺度（scale）、旋转（rotation）与方差（variance）三部分，分别解释其对学习的不同影响；3）提出一种新的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）权重校正机制，在稳定性与粒子序假设下，将标准校正方差随样本长度的指数级累积削弱为加性累积；4）将富集分析框架应用于Qwen3-1.7B在OpenMathReasoning稀疏子带上的微调实验。

Result: 理论上给出了梯度误差的尺度-旋转-方差分解，并证明SMC校正可将方差从指数累积降为加性累积；实验上通过Qwen3-1.7B的稀疏域微调，具体刻画了富集（无论是否校正）如何帮助避免稀疏域中的训练崩溃。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献在于一般性地理解富集与校正对训练的作用机制，而非主张哪种模式优于未富集的强化学习。

Abstract: When rewards are sparse, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often uses hints or intermediate guidance to generate more successful rollouts. This enrichment biases policy-gradient updates unless corrected via importance weights, but existing methods omit correction or truncate importance weights in order to avoid the high variance of correction. It thus remains unclear what exactly is gained or lost in RLVR by correcting enriched rollouts. We show, mathematically, that omitted or truncated correction implicitly reweights the defined reward, and we decompose the resulting gradient error into scale, rotation, and variance to explain their distinct effects on learning. To make correction practical, we develop a novel sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) weight correction mechanism that, under stability and particle-order assumptions, tempers the exponential compounding of standard correction variance over the length of a sample to an additive accumulation. We then apply our analysis of enrichment to interpreting the results of a fine-tune of Qwen3-1.7B on a sparse band of OpenMathReasoning, establishing a concrete mechanism of how enrichment, both corrected and uncorrected, helps avoid collapse in sparse domains. Our main contribution is to understand, in general, how enrichment and correction can affect training, as opposed to claiming that either mode of operation is superior to unenriched RL.

</details>


### [400] [Counterfactual Action Evaluation, Observation Bottlenecks, and Representation Geometry in Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02860)
*Arjun Subramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 低潜空间预测误差不能证明世界模型能区分动作后果；作者提出逐层追踪同一干预的评估协议，在可控变形物理测试台上揭示了观测可见性、表征几何与动作依赖等多重瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估常以潜空间预测误差（如 MSE）作为核心指标，但低误差可能来自表征空间塌缩或观测本身不可见，而非模型真正学到动作与物理状态之间的因果关系。论文希望验证"低预测误差是否等价于区分动作后果"，并定位误差掩盖的具体失效环节。

Method: 提出一套评估协议：在受控变形物理测试台中构造精确的模拟器状态分叉（同一干预的分支），并沿"模拟器状态→栅格观测→目标嵌入→预测器输出"逐层追踪同一反事实干预的传递效果。具体手段包括：统计一步栅格对相同的比例以度量观测可见性；比较高可见度反事实对中预测器到目标的响应幅度并与方差归一化后比较；用与目标反事实嵌入位移匹配的各向同性状态扰动作为对照，以区分"动作路径未被使用"与"预测器死亡或全局收缩"；比较 MSE-only 与 VICReg 目标编码器在潜空间误差与谱集中度上的表现；以及从全分辨率栅格与机械状态解码刚度，检验特权材料参数的可解码性。

Result: 改变指令会改变粒子运动，但 41.5% 的一步栅格对完全相同，说明观测层面存在可见性缺失。在 579 个高可见度反事实中，两个随机种子下预测器到目标响应的中位数仅为 0.0051 和 0.0217，方差归一化后进一步降至 0.0027 和 0.0116。匹配目标反事实嵌入位移的各向同性状态扰动，在相同可见对上是上述响应的 190 倍和 53 倍，表明预测器并未死亡或全局收缩，而是对动作路径利用不足。MSE-only 训练在匹配种子下 10 步潜误差低 8.36 倍，但处于谱高度集中的空间；一个 VICReg 目标编码器同样强集中，因此误差或秩都不能单独作为物理状态的证明。此外，刚度即便从全分辨率栅格和机械状态出发也接近随机水平，而特权材料参数却能完美解码，说明在该激励下可识别性弱，而非编码器丢弃信息。

Conclusion: 低潜预测误差不足以证明世界模型区分了动作后果。研究结果呼吁将物理效应、观测可见性、表征几何与动作依赖性作为相互独立的维度分别审计，而非依赖单一误差指标或表征秩来判断模型是否真正学到了物理状态。

Abstract: Low latent prediction error does not establish that a world model distinguishes the consequences of its actions. We introduce an evaluation protocol that traces the same intervention through simulator state, raster observations, target embeddings, and predictor outputs. Exact simulator-state forks in a controlled deformable-physics testbed reveal distinct bottlenecks. Changed commands alter particle motion, yet 41.5% of one-step raster pairs are identical. Observation loss is not the whole explanation: among 579 high-visibility counterfactuals, median predictor-to-target response is 0.0051 and 0.0217 across two seeds, falling to 0.0027 and 0.0116 after variance normalization. An isotropic state perturbation matched to the target counterfactual embedding shift produces 190x and 53x larger predictor changes on the same visible pairs, isolating action-path under-use rather than a dead or globally shrunk predictor. MSE-only training gives 8.36x lower 10-step latent error in matched seeds, but in spectrally concentrated spaces; one VICReg target encoder is also strongly concentrated, so neither error nor rank alone certifies physical state. Finally, stiffness remains near chance even from full-resolution rasters and mechanical state while privileged material parameters decode perfectly, indicating weak identifiability under this excitation rather than encoder discard. These results motivate auditing physical effect, observation visibility, representation geometry, and action dependence separately.

</details>


### [401] [NeuroLens: Learning Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics from Chronic Recordings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02864)
*Hanrui Lyu,Baiyuan Chen,Tianshu Tan,Matthew R. Whiteway,Maxwell D. Melin,Ji Xia,Linyang He,Bradly C. Stadie,Anne Churchland,Liam Paninski,Yizi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeuroLens，一种基于JEPA自监督框架的神经记录表征模型，通过学习去噪语义隐变量区分表征可塑性与记录不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经科学长期关注大脑高级认知的神经表征及其随时间演化，但现有分析工具难以在长期神经记录中区分"表征可塑性"与"记录不稳定"。

Method: NeuroLens基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），采用自监督学习：自适应编码器将变化的神经元群体映射到公共隐空间，时序预测器学习可预测未来隐状态的结构；在隐空间中进行预测，从而捕捉时序可预测结构并降低对瞬态、记录特异变异的敏感性。

Result: 在小鼠和人类的长期皮层内记录数据上，所学表征提升了决策与语义任务变量的解码效果；多天预训练可泛化到未来会话，实现对新神经群体的快速少样本适应，并比现有最优基线具有更稳定的长期解码性能。

Conclusion: NeuroLens为研究学习过程及长时间尺度下神经表征如何变化提供了新范式。

Abstract: Understanding how neural activity represents higher-order cognition and how these representations evolve over time has long been a central pursuit in neuroscience. However, current analytical tools cannot easily distinguish representational plasticity from recording instability in chronic neural recordings. Here, we introduce NeuroLens (Latent Embeddings of Neural Semantics), a self-supervised model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) framework that learns denoised, semantically informative latents from chronic neural recordings. An adaptive encoder maps changing neural populations into a common latent space, while a temporal predictor learns structure that supports prediction of future latent states. By predicting in latent space, NeuroLens captures temporally predictable structure and reduces sensitivity to transient, recording-specific variability. Across chronic intracortical data in mice and humans, the learned representations improve decoding of decision-making and semantic task variables. Multi-day pretraining enables generalization to future sessions, rapid few-shot adaptation to unseen neural populations, and more stable decoding over time than state-of-the-art baselines. Together, these results establish NeuroLens as a new paradigm for studying how neural representations change during learning and over long timescales.

</details>


### [402] [Divergence controls entropy in distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03529)
*Nicolas Zucchet,Scott W. Linderman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从熵的角度系统研究了大语言模型蒸馏的性质，证明前向KL会膨胀学生模型熵，而反向KL会收缩熵，散度本身充当隐式熵正则化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练的核心方法，但其性质尚未被充分理解。作者希望从熵的视角揭示不同散度对蒸馏中学生模型的影响机制，从而更深入地理解蒸馏过程的本质规律。

Method: 采用信息论中熵的分析框架，研究学生模型熵如何依赖数据及定义蒸馏目标的散度。理论上证明前向KL使学生熵高于教师；将交叉熵训练作为特例得到恒等式并在预训练与监督微调中定量验证；分析反向KL及散度插值对熵的影响，并对比on-policy蒸馏中熵降低的来源（token级反向KL而非on-policy采样）。

Result: 前向KL会膨胀学生熵，交叉熵作为特例的恒等式在预训练和监督微调中得到定量验证；反向KL会收缩熵，直到学生与教师差距过大；两者插值早期平滑变化，但在收敛时突变；on-policy蒸馏的低熵来源于token级反向KL而非on-policy采样。

Conclusion: 散度充当隐式熵正则化器，其作用在自蒸馏中最为明显：由于以特权信息为条件会收缩熵，最优的散度超参数正是那些能补偿这一效应的参数。

Abstract: Distillation has become a core primitive of large language model training, but its properties are not yet well understood. We take an entropic perspective, studying how the entropy of the student depends on the data and the divergence that define the distillation objective. We prove that forward KL inflates the entropy of the student above that of the teacher. Since cross-entropy training is a special case, this yields an identity that we verify quantitatively in pretraining and supervised finetuning. Other divergences come with no such guarantee: reverse KL deflates entropy until the gap between student and teacher gets too large, and interpolating between the two changes entropy smoothly early in training but abruptly at convergence. The lower entropy of on-policy distillation comes from token-level reverse KL, not from on-policy sampling. The divergence therefore acts as an implicit entropy regularizer, whose role is clearest in self-distillation: as conditioning on privileged information deflates entropy, the divergence hyperparameters that work best are those that compensate for it.

</details>


### [403] [On Unlearning for Time-series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02865)
*Zeyu Shi,Yanhui Luo,Ziming Hong,Chongyang Gao,Kezhen Chen,Shanshan Ye,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RDTU，一个基于残差扩散的时间序列机器遗忘框架，通过NTK预测器生成删除兼容基线预测，用扩散模型估计反事实预测形成伪标签场，引导轻量级模型更新，使遗忘后模型最接近完全重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序预测常用于敏感场景，模型基于用户或实体级纵向记录训练，可能因隐私、专有信息或传感器故障需删除数据。重训成本高，机器遗忘是替代方案，但时序遗忘存在三大挑战：基于梯度的遗忘不稳定（删除的观测参与多个因果关联的预测窗口，参数更新会扩散出目标区间，损害保留预测效用）；标签引导更新缺乏合适的替代目标（连续且依赖上下文的预测没有替换标签，且遗忘时无法获得精确重训输出）；被删除时序模式的剩余支持高度非均匀（部分受影响窗口在保留数据中有结构相似对应，另一些则被欠表征或孤立）。

Method: RDTU包含三步：首先用保留集神经正切核（NTK）预测器获得删除兼容的基线预测；其次利用保留参考数据的体积贡献量化每个受影响窗口的全局和局部结构支持；最后用扩散模型生成残差修正以估计反事实预测，形成伪标签场，引导轻量级模型更新。

Result: 实验表明，RDTU持续产生与精确重训最接近的遗忘后模型。

Conclusion: RDTU通过残差扩散与伪标签引导，有效解决时序机器遗忘中梯度不稳定与目标缺失问题，在无需重训的前提下实现接近精确重训的遗忘效果。

Abstract: Time-series forecasting is widely used in sensitive domains. Models in these settings are often trained on longitudinal user- or entity-level records, which may later require removal because they contain sensitive or proprietary information or have been corrupted by sensor failures. To address such deletion requests without costly retraining, machine unlearning has been widely studied as a practical mechanism for privacy protection and data governance. However, the application of machine unlearning to time series prediction has not yet been well realized; this is mainly due to the following unique challenges: Gradient-based unlearning can be unstable because a deleted observation participates in multiple causally connected forecasting windows, causing parameter updates to propagate beyond the requested interval and degrade retained forecasting utility. Label-guided updating offers a more controlled alternative, but continuous and context-dependent forecasts lack a suitable replacement target, while the exact-retrained output is unavailable during unlearning. Moreover, the remaining support for a deleted temporal pattern is highly non-uniform. Some affected windows retain structurally similar counterparts in the retained data, whereas others become underrepresented or isolated. We present RDTU, a Residual Diffusion framework for time-series unlearning. RDTU first uses a retained-set neural tangent kernel predictor to obtain a deletion-compatible base forecast. Then it quantifies the global and local structural support of each affected window using the volume contribution of the retained-reference data. Then a diffusion model generates a residual correction that estimates the counterfactual forecast, yielding a pseudo-label field that guides a lightweight model update. Experiments show that RDTU consistently produces unlearned models that most closely match exact retraining.

</details>


### [404] [DIVINE: Simple Cross-Market Stock Pretraining via Diverse Indicator Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02866)
*Kuan-Yu Chen,Shu-Cheng Zheng,Yu-Chen Den,Wei-Cheng Liao,Tien-Hao Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出DIVINE，一种跨市场金融时序预训练框架，通过从原始OHLCV历史重建技术指标来学习可迁移的股票排序表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融时序预训练目标（掩码观测、对比关系、未来结果）难以同时规避未来监督的不确定性与保持收益预测对齐。

Method: 以观测到的价量历史计算技术指标作为监督目标，构建跨六个股票市场的联合预训练，重建由16个标准指标衍生的77个目标，仅将编码器迁移到下游股票排序任务。

Result: 在六个市场上取得最强平均组合表现，仅用0.05M参数编码器即超越预训练基线，并匹敌或超过更大的金融基础模型，同时具备鲁棒性与数据效率。

Conclusion: 指标多样性与市场多样性在迁移中带来互补增益，表明监督设计与跨市场多样性而非模型规模才是强可迁移金融表征的关键。

Abstract: Financial time-series pretraining typically learns from masked observations, contrastive relations, or future outcomes---yet existing objectives struggle to simultaneously avoid future-supervision uncertainty and maintain return-prediction alignment. We propose DIVINE (DIVerse INdicator rEconstruction), a simple cross-market pretraining framework that reconstructs technical indicators from raw OHLCV history. Computed from observed price-volume history, technical indicators provide consistently defined supervision across markets while summarizing diverse market dynamics with established relevance to return prediction. Pretrained jointly on six-equity market datasets, DIVINE reconstructs 77 targets derived from 16 standard indicators and transfers only the learned encoder to downstream stock ranking. Across all six markets, DIVINE achieves the strongest average portfolio performance with a lightweight 0.05M-parameter encoder, outperforming pretraining baselines and matching or exceeding substantially larger financial foundation models, while remaining robust and data-efficient. Systematic analyses show that indicator diversity and market diversity provide complementary gains in transfer. Together, these results suggest that supervision design and cross-market diversity---rather than model scale---are the key drivers of strong, transferable financial representations.

</details>


### [405] [Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03665)
*Seo Hyun Kim,Sunwoo Hong,Younwoo Choi,Chen-Hao Chao,Se-Young Yun,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pivot-SD：一种针对掩码扩散语言模型的离线自蒸馏框架，仅监督高影响力的"关键承诺"（pivots），用200个问题和4次采样即超越全序列SFT与同等预算的扩散RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLMs）在复杂推理上具备并行优势，但存在独特的信用分配难题：去噪过程中少数几个承诺会大幅降低其余掩码位置的不确定性，并决定响应的大部分内容。现有后训练方法未利用该信号，通常对最终文本训练或对整步去噪赋奖励，而非挑选真正塑造响应的关键承诺。

Method: 提出 Pivot-SD 离线自蒸馏框架：用信息增益度量（其余掩码位置的不确定性下降程度）挑选 pivots；对成功轨迹中的 pivots 用交叉熵训练，对失败轨迹中的 pivots 用定向 unlikelihood 训练，其余失败轨迹部分不更新。

Result: 仅使用200个问题、每个4次 rollout，Pivot-SD 在数学与代码基准上优于 full-sequence SFT 以及预算匹配的扩散 RL 基线（以 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 为基座）。

Conclusion: 聚焦高影响力关键承诺的细粒度信用分配，是提升掩码扩散语言模型推理能力的样本高效后训练路径。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [406] [Distributionally Robust Survival Models under Subpopulation Shift and Outlier Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02868)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种分布鲁棒生存分析框架，联合处理潜在亚群偏移与离群点污染，在污染场景下稳定训练并显著提升最差组性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生存模型在分布偏移下鲁棒性不足：异质人群中模型平均表现好但某些亚群表现差，且训练数据受离群点污染时问题更严重。现有方法难以同时应对潜在亚群偏移与离群点污染，且生存损失（如Cox负偏对数似然）具有不可分解性和风险集结构，难以直接套用通用鲁棒优化方法。

Method: 提出分布鲁棒生存分析框架，采用min-max形式：外层最小化通过降低污染样本影响来选取精炼的名义分布，内层最大化聚焦最具挑战性的亚群。该形式直接适配不可分解的生存损失，并保留样本间交互（Cox损失的风险集结构）。设计基于交替梯度的算法，外层更新由内层最大化的KKT条件导出。

Result: 在模拟数据和两个生存分析基准上实验表明：当亚群偏移与离群点污染同时发生时方法保持鲁棒；在污染环境下稳定训练；在线性与非线性生存模型上均大幅提升最差组性能，同时整体性能具有竞争力、有时更优。

Conclusion: 该工作为生存分析提供了一种统一应对亚群偏移与离群点污染的分布鲁棒方案，兼顾最差组鲁棒性与整体性能，并有理论条件支撑的优化算法。

Abstract: Learning robust survival models under distribution shift is an important but challenging problem in many applications. In heterogeneous populations, a model that performs well on average may still perform poorly on certain subpopulations, and this issue becomes even more severe when the training data are contaminated by outliers. In this paper, we propose a novel distributionally robust framework for survival analysis that jointly addresses latent subpopulation shift and outlier contamination. The proposed method combines an outer minimization that selects a refined nominal distribution by reducing the influence of contaminated samples and an inner maximization that focuses on the most challenging subpopulation. This formulation directly accommodates non-decomposable survival losses while preserving interactions across samples, including the risk-set structure of the Cox negative partial log-likelihood. We develop an alternating gradient-based algorithm with outer updates derived from the KKT conditions of the inner maximization. Experiments on simulated data and two survival benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method remains robust when subpopulation shift and outlier contamination occur simultaneously. It stabilizes training in contaminated settings and substantially improves worst-group performance across both linear and nonlinear survival models, while maintaining competitive and sometimes superior overall performance.

</details>


### [407] [Peer Effects in Signed Networks: Separating Influence Through Positive and Negative Ties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02872)
*Xiaojing Du,Jiuyong Li,Lin Liu,Debo Cheng,Jixue Liu,Thuc Duy Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出区分正负社会关系（支持性与对抗性纽带）的因果推断框架，并开发了双重稳健估计方法 SiDE，用于评估网络干预中的同伴效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的网络干预评估通常只统计受处理的邻居数量，而不区分支持性与对抗性关系，这可能掩盖方向相反的影响，导致因果效应估计出现混杂与偏差。作者希望通过区分正负纽带及其交互，更准确地刻画治疗通过社会关系传播的效果。

Method: 论文将效应定义为正向纽带效应、负向纽带效应、二者的交互效应，以及在固定总治疗量下在两类纽带间重新分配治疗的符号构成效应，并给出各自的识别公式。作者指出在"符号盲"分配下，忽略符号会混合两类纽带的效应。为此提出 SiDE（Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator），它结合符号特异的结局模型与由个体治疗分配诱导的暴露概率，并证明其得分函数的双重稳健性，同时评估考虑邻域重叠的近似置信区间。

Result: 在六个真实符号网络上的半合成实验表明，该方法能准确估计效应，并揭示了区间覆盖率的局限。对已发表学校实验数据的探索性再分析显示，通过"共度时间"纽带对手环佩戴的同伴效应估计为正，但在多重比较校正后，全部四种效应的置信区间均包含零。

Conclusion: 该框架通过揭示两类纽带的影响何时相互增强或相互抵消，可为网络干预设计提供指导，强调了在同伴效应研究中区分关系符号的重要性。

Abstract: Evaluating network interventions requires understanding how treatment affects people through their social relationships. Counting treated neighbors without distinguishing supportive and antagonistic ties can conceal opposing influences. We define effects through positive and negative ties, their interaction, and a sign-composition effect of reallocating treatment between the two types at a fixed total, and give their identification formulas. Under sign-blind assignment, we show how ignoring signs mixes the effects of the two tie types. We propose SiDE (Signed-exposure Doubly robust Estimator), which combines sign-specific outcome models with exposure probabilities induced by individual treatment assignment. We establish double robustness of its score and assess approximate intervals that account for overlapping neighborhoods. Semi-synthetic experiments on six real signed networks demonstrate accurate effect estimation and examine the limits of interval coverage. An exploratory reanalysis of published school-experiment data yields a positive estimate of the peer effect through spend-time ties on wristband wearing, but the intervals for all four effects include zero after adjustment for multiple comparisons. This framework can inform network intervention design by showing when influences through the two tie types reinforce or offset one another.

</details>


### [408] [Toward Omni Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Topology-Driven Binding Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02881)
*Xunkai Li,Chenxi Wan,Yinlin Zhu,Wang Luo,Hongchao Qin,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GraphBind，一种由拓扑驱动的多模态图基础模型方法，用图拓扑把模态信息绑定到统一共享空间，在判别与生成任务上均超越 11 个基线，最高相对提升 28.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的多模态属性图常存在节点属性不完整的问题，限制了预训练语料的规模与多样性；同时现有 MGFM 大多只把图拓扑当作结构上下文，忽视了其在引导多模态绑定、塑造统一表示空间方面的作用。

Method: GraphBind 基于图拓扑的稳定性，将其作为结构参考与互补语义信息，用于把自语义与可靠的邻域语义组织进一个融合结构与语义的全局共享空间，并通过轻量级接口将该空间适配到判别式与生成式任务。

Result: 在 11 个代表性基线的对比实验中，GraphBind 在判别式与生成式任务上均取得领先性能，相对最强基线最高提升 28.1%。

Conclusion: 以拓扑为驱动的多模态绑定能够有效缓解属性不完整问题，并构建统一共享表示空间，为多模态图基础模型提供了一条更具泛化性的技术路径。

Abstract: Multimodal graph foundation models (MGFMs) seek to learn generalizable representations from large-scale graphs with heterogeneous node modalities. However, real-world Multimodal-Attributed Graphs (MAGs) often contain incomplete node attributes, limiting the scale and diversity of available pretraining corpora. Besides, existing MGFMs primarily incorporate graph topology as structural context, overlooking its role in guiding multimodal binding and shaping a unified representation space. To address these challenges, we propose GraphBind, a topology-driven approach that uses graph topology to bind rich modality information into a unified shared space. GraphBind is motivated by the stability of graph topology, which provides structural references and complementary semantic information for multimodal binding. Concretely, GraphBind uses topology to organize self semantics and reliable neighborhood semantics into a global shared space that integrates structure and semantics, and adapts this space to discriminative and generative tasks through lightweight interfaces. Extensive experiments against 11 representative baselines demonstrate that GraphBind achieves leading performance on both discriminative and generative tasks, with relative improvements of up to 28.1% over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [409] [WebFovea: When the Model Is Right but the Click Is Wrong -- Reliable Round Trips for Vision-Based Web Agents on Live Websites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03036)
*Jiangang Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WebFovea 是一个基于视觉的网页智能体，在 WebRetriever Challenge 2026 中获得第二名（57.0/100）。论文强调：多模态大模型是必要条件但非充分条件，真正的瓶颈在于模型与页面之间的"执行框架"（harness）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在真实网站的端到端任务中，许多失败并非源于模型推理能力不足，而是发生在模型与浏览器之间的执行环节。作者希望揭示并解决这些被忽视的系统性瓶颈。

Method: 作者提出"四阶段"框架：模型回复须被正确解析为动作、动作须在页面上生效、结果须被准确回传、模型须看到所需信息。WebFovea 对每个阶段进行加固，并加入护栏以约束智能体行为与预算，同时修复坐标空间不匹配、下拉框/iframe/文本框操作静默失败、自生成聊天模板 token 污染（4.9% 任务回合）等问题。

Result: 在四份提交中使用同一模型，官方隐藏集分数从 31.0 提升至 57.0，说明提升主要来自执行框架的改进（含运行间方差）。文中还给出了各组件证据（含负面结果）与失败分析。

Conclusion: 四阶段视角不依赖具体模型，但部分修复依赖模型。作者讨论了局限性并给出路线图，包括将不同步骤路由到不同模型。

Abstract: We present WebFovea, a vision-based web agent that placed 2nd in the WebRetriever Challenge 2026 with a final score of 57.0 out of 100. The challenge evaluates agents end to end on Protocol III of the WebRetriever benchmark (arXiv:2607.06118): starting from an entry URL on a live website, the agent must operate the site's own interface and return a verifiable answer. A capable multimodal large language model (LLM) is necessary for this, but not sufficient. The model's decisions reach the browser through the harness, the code between the model and the page. At every step, four things must go right: the model's reply must be parsed into the intended action, the action must take effect on the page, the result must be reported back accurately, and the model must be shown the information it needs. On real websites, many of the failures we observed occurred at one of these four stages rather than in the model's reasoning. A coordinate-space mismatch placed every click at 3/4 of its intended coordinates; actions on native dropdowns, inside iframes, and in text boxes failed silently; and self-generated chat-template tokens contaminated 4.9% of task episodes. WebFovea hardens each stage and surrounds the loop with guardrails that keep the agent within the rules and its budget. The four-stage view does not depend on the model, although some individual fixes do. Because we used the same model in all four submissions, the rise of our official hidden-set score from 31.0 to 57.0 reflects changes to the harness, up to run-to-run variance on live sites. We describe the design, the evidence for each component (including negative results), a failure analysis, the limitations, and a roadmap that includes routing different steps to different models.

</details>


### [410] [DyRA: Dynamic Residual Approximation for Efficient Matrix Multiplication in DNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02882)
*Daewon Chae,Hyunwon Chung,Changwoo Lee,Hun-Seok Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DyRA通过输入自适应地校正结构化权重近似产生的输出残差误差，在相同计算预算下更忠实地逼近全矩阵乘法，在视觉、语音和语言模型上均改善精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模基础模型因密集矩阵乘法导致推理成本高昂。已有方法用低秩分解等高效结构化形式替代密集权重矩阵，但这些方法近似的是权重而非决定推理精度的输出激活，权重空间的微小误差会被输入激活放大，导致较大的输出误差。

Method: 提出DyRA（输入自适应方法）。核心洞察是：直接优化输出的低秩因子能更有效地近似矩阵乘法。DyRA据此在推理时动态地近似并校正结构化权重近似引入的输出误差，将高效结构化计算与输入相关的校正相结合。

Result: 在视觉、语音和语言模型上，DyRA均持续优于仅使用结构化权重近似的方法，改善精度-效率权衡。在DINOv3上实现1.5倍端到端GPU加速，同时将精度退化相比仅权重基线降低超过3倍。

Conclusion: 通过从权重近似转向输出近似并对输出残差进行输入自适应校正，可在相同计算预算下获得更忠实的矩阵乘法近似，是一种有效提升大模型推理效率的通用思路。

Abstract: Large-scale foundation models achieve strong performance across diverse tasks, but their size makes inference costly, largely due to dense matrix multiplications. Prior work reduces this cost by replacing dense weight matrices with efficient structured forms such as low-rank factorizations. However, these methods approximate weights rather than the output activations that determine inference accuracy. Consequently, small weight-space errors can be amplified by input activations, producing large output errors. In this work, we propose DyRA, an input-adaptive method that improves structured matrix multiplication approximation by correcting residual output errors during inference. We show that matrix multiplication can be approximated more effectively by directly optimizing low-rank factors of the output. DyRA builds on this insight by dynamically approximating and correcting the output error introduced by structured weight approximations. This combines efficient structured computation with input-dependent correction, yielding a more faithful approximation of full matrix multiplication under the same computational budget. Across vision, speech, and language models, DyRA consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over structured weight approximations alone. Notably, DyRA achieves a 1.5$\times$ end-to-end GPU speedup for DINOv3 while reducing accuracy degradation by more than 3$\times$ relative to weight-only baselines.

</details>


### [411] [When Can We Trust the Matching Principle? Robust Deployment Geometry Under Finite-Sample and Model Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02894)
*Vishal Rajput*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"信任比率"τ=ε/γ量化是否进行几何匹配，并给出线性二次Matching响应下的漂移界，提出置信校准匹配（CCM）策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在几何/投影子空间匹配任务中，全部匹配（always-match）并非总是最优，估计不确定性可能导致匹配反而劣于弃权（abstain），需要一种准则来判断何时匹配、何时"摊薄惩罚"。

Method: 定义信任比率 τ = ε/γ（估计不确定性比谱分离度）。在 Davis-Kahan 分离区域 τ < 1/2 下，分析线性二次 Matching 响应中估计投影与 oracle 投影之间的 oracle 相对漂移，其量级为 O(τ²)。在此基础上提出 Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM)：当 τ 小时采用方向性（匹配）策略，τ 大时逐步转为各向同性（软化）策略，阈值由校准而非定理给出。

Result: 实验展示了两种机制的存在，包括在 UCI HAR 嵌入上，"始终匹配"在每个单元上都劣于"弃权"。

Conclusion: 以 τ 为核心的准则可将"是否匹配"转化为可控策略；CCM 提供了一种可校准的实务方案，但需注意其理论适用区与启发式部分的区别。

Abstract: Match only geometry you can identify; otherwise spread the penalty. We quantify that decision by the trust ratio tau = epsilon / gamma (estimation uncertainty over spectral separation). Under the linear-quadratic Matching response, oracle-relative drift between estimated and oracle projector matching scales as tau^2 for probes in the chosen top-r deployment subspace -- O(tau^2) in the Davis-Kahan separation region tau < 1/2, with practical usefulness depending on constants. Confidence-Calibrated Matching (CCM) turns tau into a policy -- directional when tau is small, progressively isotropic when not -- with thresholds from calibration, not from the theorem (match sits in the separation region; soft is mostly heuristic). Experiments show both regimes, including UCI HAR embeddings where always-match is worse than abstain on every cell.

</details>


### [412] [What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713)
*Nishit Anand,Ramani Duraiswami,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文主张持续世界模型应以"按不变性时间尺度分层的保留"取代统一遗忘度量，并提出 differential retention 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习沿用静态预测目标的传统，把对旧数据的性能下降一律视为失败；但世界模型的预测目标是不断变化的环境，旧知识过时后应被修正，而非视为灾难性遗忘。现有概念漂移与语言模型时效性研究未针对世界模型（既有绝不可修正的知识，又有必须及时修正的知识）进行形式化。

Method: 提出按不变性时间尺度分层的保留机制：将物理规律、客体永久性等不变量与实例级事实区分开；并提出 differential retention 指标，在适应流上联合报告不变量回归测试与修正延迟，且不进行聚合。

Result: 标准遗忘度量无法区分"正确修正过时知识"与"灾难性遗忘"，因而会把冻结模型排为最优；而现有物理推理基准也只评估冻结的检查点。

Conclusion: 持续世界模型需要新的评估范式，应分别度量不可修正知识的保持与可变知识修正的及时性，而非使用单一聚合的遗忘分数。

Abstract: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.

</details>


### [413] [Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching: Learning Stochastic Transport with Mechanistic Sensitivities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02906)
*Jowaria Khan,Elizabeth Bondi-Kelly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Tangent-SBM，从端点观测与机制敏感性中学习随机输运，在多种随机系统上提升敏感性与有限变化预测精度，并改善决策效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机系统对黏度、反应速率或外力变化的响应预测依赖昂贵仿真，需要可复用的学习模型；但仅匹配观测结果分布无法保证对干预响应的准确性。

Method: Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching（Tangent-SBM）：在轨迹传播中同时传播参数导数，并用给定目标进行监督；针对平均响应目标，采用两次独立 rollout 匹配均值，避免单次 rollout 平方误差额外惩罚响应变异性；并建立敏感性精度对有限变化预测误差与决策后悔的界定条件。

Result: 在 Gaussian、随机双井、PDEBench 反应-扩散、随机 Navier–Stokes 系统上，Tangent-SBM 相比匹配的条件桥基线提升了敏感性与有限变化预测，同时保持可比的端点与分布精度；消融检验了目标正确性、响应目标与仿真预算分配；在 Navier–Stokes 校准黏度选择任务中，相较不采取行动降低了跟踪误差。

Conclusion: Tangent-SBM 能学习更可靠的干预响应模型，兼顾端点/分布匹配与敏感性预测，并在实际决策任务中体现价值。该工作属于 Other（非 LLM/MLLM，偏随机系统建模与科学计算）。

Abstract: Predicting how stochastic systems respond to changes in viscosity, reaction rates, or external forces requires costly simulations, motivating reusable learned models. Yet matching observed outcome distributions does not ensure accurate intervention responses. We introduce Tangent Schrödinger Bridge Matching (Tangent-SBM), which learns stochastic transports from endpoint observations and mechanistic sensitivities. It propagates parameter derivatives alongside trajectories and supervises them against supplied targets. For average-response targets, single-rollout squared error also penalizes response variability; our objective uses two independent rollouts to match the mean without this additional penalty. We establish conditions under which sensitivity accuracy bounds finite-change prediction error and decision regret. Across Gaussian, stochastic double-well, PDEBench reaction--diffusion, and stochastic Navier--Stokes systems, Tangent-SBM improves sensitivity and finite-change prediction over matched conditional-bridge baselines while maintaining comparable endpoint and distributional accuracy. Controls examine target correctness, response objectives, and simulator-budget allocation. To test decision usefulness, we evaluate calibrated viscosity selection in Navier--Stokes: Tangent-SBM reduces tracking error relative to taking no action on every evaluated task.

</details>


### [414] [Do ResNets Route? Sparse Interaction Experts in Residual Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02907)
*Liang Yan,Siying Chen,Kaijie Chen,Bo Li,Jinghao Zhang,Mu Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将训练好的ResNet建模为关于二值残差分支掩码的集合函数，用Möbius反演把输出精确分解为各阶残差修正与高阶交互，发现ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18/34的交互质量峰值出现在五阶和十阶而非低阶，且主导交互随输入与预测类别变化，从而表明稠密ResNet隐含实现了"软路由"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ResNet对每个输入都执行所有残差块，但其功能贡献未必与输入无关。作者希望探究残差分支的贡献是否依赖输入，以及稠密网络中是否存在隐式的、无需显式路由器或稀疏执行的"路由"机制。

Method: 将训练好的ResNet表述为二元残差分支掩码上的集合函数，对输出做Möbius反演，精确分解为单阶残差修正与高阶交互项；在残差缩放假设下证明固定k阶交互量级为O(λ^k)；对ImageNet预训练的ResNet-18与ResNet-34进行穷举式交互谱分析，并考察残差缩放、系数稀疏性、交互随输入/类别/样本难度的变化。

Result: 交互质量峰值分别出现在ResNet-18的五阶和ResNet-34的十阶，而非低阶；减小残差尺度使谱向低阶移动但会改变预测；交互系数幅值集中但并非硬稀疏，保预测的稀疏性随深度减弱；主导交互在共享全局核心之外随输入与预测类别变化，但其整体复杂度随样本难度变化很小。

Conclusion: 稠密ResNet实现了一种隐式的软路由：每个块都被执行，但不同输入依赖不同的残差交互"专家"。因此路由可以在功能贡献层面自发涌现，而无需显式路由器或稀疏执行。

Abstract: Residual networks execute every block for every input, yet their functional contributions need not be input independent. We formulate a trained ResNet as a set function over binary residual-branch masks and apply Möbius inversion to decompose its output exactly into individual residual corrections and higher-order interactions. For smooth residual stacks, we show that each fixed $k$-way interaction scales as $\mathcal{O}(λ^k)$ under residual scaling. Exhaustive analysis of ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 and ResNet-34 reveals that interaction mass peaks at orders five and ten, respectively, rather than at low orders. Reducing the residual scale shifts both spectra toward lower orders, but also changes model predictions. The interaction coefficients are concentrated in magnitude but not hard sparse, and prediction-preserving sparsity weakens with depth. Crucially, the dominant interactions vary across inputs and predicted classes around a shared global core, while their overall complexity changes little with sample difficulty. These results show that dense ResNets implement an implicit form of soft routing: every block is executed, but different inputs rely on different residual interaction experts. Routing can therefore emerge at the level of functional contribution without an explicit router or sparse execution.

</details>


### [415] [Constraint-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02909)
*Jinwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"约束感知"训练目标，将推理阶段的程序分析约束从训练中外部化，并从理论上证明外部化在模型规模与数据效率上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型生成程序时常在解码阶段用程序分析（语法、作用域、类型规则）排除非法token，但标准训练也已教会模型抑制这些token，造成重复。作者追问：既然推理时反正要过滤，能否在训练时干脆不教这部分分析，从而获得更高效的模型。

Method: 定义了一个满足"外部化"要求的通用约束感知目标，将推理期分析所排除的token空间从训练信号中剥离；并通过三定理形式化外部化在模型规模与数据效率上的收益；最后设计受控合成实验验证理论在训练动态下依然成立。

Result: 在相同参数量与数据条件下，约束感知训练相比普通交叉熵训练取得更低的预测损失，说明理论收益在真实训练动态中得以保持。

Conclusion: 应鼓励采用将生成阶段所用程序分析直接纳入的训练目标，使训练与推理协同，实现更高效的模型。

Abstract: When generating programs with language models, constrained decoding can apply program analyses to exclude tokens that violate syntax, scope, or typing rules. However, there is a duplication: standard training already teaches the model to suppress the tokens rejected by these analyses. This duplication leads to the question: if we will perform some analysis to filter a set tokens out during inference anyways, can we avoid teaching the model the said analysis altogether during training, and does this externalization lead to more efficient models? This paper defines a general constraint-aware objective satisfying this externalization desideratum and formalizes the benefits of externalization into three concrete theorems about model size and data efficiency. We show, through a controlled synthetic experiment, that the theorems survive training dynamics: constraint-aware training yields lower prediction loss at a matched parameter count and data compared to ordinary cross-entropy training, motivating training objectives that incorporate the analyses used during generation.

</details>


### [416] [SlimKV: Joint Token-Feature KV Cache Compression with Reconstruction-Free Beacon Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02953)
*Zihan Teng,Jiayu Zhao,Wentao Ren,Minhao Fan,Tianrui Ma,Song Chen,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SlimKV 提出一种问题无关的联合 token-特征 KV-cache 压缩方法，通过低秩感知训练与层自适应秩分配压缩长上下文，并利用 K-RoPE 位置不对称性在潜空间进行注意力计算，实现高效长上下文推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 服务受制于 KV-cache 内存开销，尤其在资源受限场景下。现有压缩方法存在两难：token 级方法（驱逐/凝聚）有信息损失风险，特征级方法若要恢复全维度以施加位置编码，则会限制解码加速。

Method: 提出 SlimKV：1）问题无关的联合 token-特征压缩，用低秩感知训练将长上下文压缩为带潜 KV 表示的 beacon memory 状态；2）层自适应秩分配；3）发现位置不对称性（移除 key 侧 RoPE 对 beacon token 的退化远小于原始 token），据此在 K-RoPE-free 约束下训练 beacon KV 投影，并在解码时进行潜空间注意力。

Result: 在 LongBench 上，16x/32x 压缩率下优于基线，4x/8x 下保持领先并保留超过 96% 的未压缩模型分数；Needle-in-a-Haystack 验证了跨证据位置的鲁棒性；128K 长度下注意力加速最高 7.34x，端到端解码加速最高 3.38x。

Conclusion: SlimKV 通过联合 token-特征压缩与位置不对称性利用，在保持长上下文性能的同时显著降低 KV-cache 开销并提升解码效率。

Abstract: Long-context LLM serving is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache memory, especially in resource-constrained scenarios. Among existing KV-cache compression strategies, token-wise methods reduce cached states but risk information loss through eviction or condensation, while feature-wise methods reduce per-token KV dimensions but can require full-dimensional reconstruction to apply positional embedding, limiting decoding speedups. We introduce SlimKV, a question-agnostic joint token-feature KV-cache compression method. SlimKV uses low-rank-aware training to compress long contexts into beacon memory states with latent KV representations, together with layer-adaptive rank allocation. We further uncover a positional asymmetry: removing key-side RoPE affects beacon and raw tokens differently, with much smaller degradation for beacon tokens. Exploiting this asymmetry, SlimKV trains beacon KV projections under a K-RoPE-free constraint and enables latent-space attention during decoding, mitigating reconstruction latency. On LongBench, SlimKV outperforms baselines at 16x/32x compression and remains leading at 4x/8x, where it retains over 96% of the uncompressed model's score. Needle-in-a-Haystack confirms robustness across evidence positions, and efficiency evaluation shows up to 7.34x attention speedup and 3.38x end-to-end decoding speedup over the uncompressed model at 128K length.

</details>


### [417] [Hyperparameter selection for equation learning with biologically-informed neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02954)
*William Lavery,Jodie A. Cochrane,John T. Nardini,Sara Hamis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套用于生物信息神经网络（BINNs）超参数选择的诊断工作流，围绕网络容量、训练轮数与学习项稳定性三个问题，在多个已知真值的合成系统上验证，并总结实用经验规则与推荐起始超参数值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BINNs 适合从稀疏、含噪、不完整数据中学习生物系统高度非线性的偏微分方程，但其实际应用严重依赖超参数选择。现有研究中超参数多以启发式方式选取且记录粗略，损害了结果的可复现性与方法的可迁移性，因此需要一套在真值方程未知时也能使用的系统化超参数选择流程。

Method: 作者提出一套诊断工作流，由三个问题引导：更大的网络容量带来的收益是否值得其代价；增加训练轮数是否持续降低验证损失；学习到的项是否随网络容量与训练增加而趋于稳定。随后在具有已知真值的合成系统上应用该流程，系统复杂度涵盖扩散项与生长项（方程右端项），数据维度从 1D+t 到 2D+t。

Result: 实验表明验证损失总体上能够跟随学习项的真实误差变化；据此提炼出 BINN 架构中选取超参数的实用经验规则，并给出建议的起始取值。工作流在不同复杂度的合成系统上均得到验证。

Conclusion: 该工作通过提供结构化的工作流、实践指南以及超参数选择的推荐起始值，降低了基于 BINN 进行方程学习的门槛，提升了结果的可复现性与方法的可迁移性。

Abstract: Biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) have emerged as a flexible subclass of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for learning terms in partial differential equations from data. BINNs are particularly suited for biological systems, where the governing equations are highly nonlinear and only partially known a priori, and where data observations are often sparse, noisy, and incomplete. However, applying BINNs effectively in practice depends critically on hyperparameter selection, which remains a central challenge in equation-learning frameworks. Hyperparameters are often chosen heuristically and only cursorily documented, which limits the reproducibility of results and the transferability of methods. We present a diagnostic workflow for hyperparameter selection that can be used when the ground-truth equations are not known. The workflow is guided by three main questions: (1) Are the benefits of greater network capacity worth the cost? (2) Do more training epochs keep reducing the validation loss? (3) Do the learned terms stop changing as network capacity and training increase? We apply our workflow to synthetic systems of varying complexity with known ground truth, spanning diffusion and growth right-hand side terms and data ranging from 1D+t to 2D+t. We demonstrate that the validation loss generally follows the true error in the learned terms and distil practical rules of thumb for selecting hyperparameters in the BINN architecture. By providing a structured workflow, practical guidelines, and suggested starting values for hyperparameter selection, this work lowers the barrier to BINN-based equation learning.

</details>


### [418] [Dirac-Interconnected Neural Elements: Discovering Modularity in Physical Systems Without Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02960)
*Reiho Li,Razmik Arman Khosrovian,Takaharu Yaguchi,Hiroaki Yoshimura,Takashi Matsubara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Dirac互联神经元件（DINEs），将物理系统建模为微分代数方程（DAE），其代数约束由核表示下的Dirac结构给出，可同时从数据识别互联结构并学习元件特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习建模动力系统依赖物理先验（如能量守恒、辛结构）作为归纳偏置，但未充分利用真实物理系统是元件互联这一事实：部分方法要求互联结构已知，部分方法将系统约简为ODE并只学习约简后的ODE，丢弃了互联带来的代数约束。

Method: 提出DINEs：用微分代数方程表示物理系统，代数约束由核表示下的Dirac结构给出；从数据中同时辨识元件间的互联（作为Dirac结构）并学习元件特性（神经网络安全）；保持子系统为非约简形式，可隔离或组合成新系统而无需重训练；并能处理部分可观测系统。

Result: 实验表明DINEs具备上述能力（识别互联、非约简子系统的隔离与组合、处理部分可观测），并在超出既有方法能力范围的物理系统上得到验证。

Conclusion: DINEs以Dirac结构的核表示刻画互联约束，兼顾互联辨识与元件学习，为物理系统建模提供可组合、支持部分观测的新框架。

Abstract: Deep learning has shown remarkable success in the data-driven modeling of dynamical systems. Much of its success is attributed not to the flexibility of neural networks but to inductive biases based on physical prior knowledge, such as energy conservation and symplecticity. However, existing methods do not fully exploit the fact that real-world physical systems are interconnections of components. Some methods require the interconnection to be known a priori, while others assume the system to be reducible to an ordinary differential equation (ODE) and learn only the reduced ODE, discarding the algebraic constraints imposed by the interconnection. Here, we propose Dirac-interconnected neural elements (DINEs), a neural network model that represents a physical system as a differential-algebraic equation (DAE), whose algebraic constraints are given by a Dirac structure in kernel representation. With DINEs, we simultaneously identify from data the interconnection among the components as a Dirac structure and learn the characteristics of the components as neural networks. This allows us to keep the learned subsystems in unreduced form and isolate or compose them to make a new system without retraining. Moreover, DINEs can handle partially observable systems. Experimental results demonstrate these capabilities on physical systems beyond the reach of existing methods.

</details>


### [419] [Differentiable Koopman Operator for Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02990)
*Md Abrar Jahin,Taufikur Rahman Fuad,Md Rizwan Parvez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KAIROS自监督框架，将可微Koopman算子嵌入动态图对比学习，实现时序演化线性化，在九个动态图基准上取得SOTA异常检测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界交互网络本质上是动态的，边随时间形成与消失。多数基于快照的对比方法仅隐式地在编码器权重中编码时序依赖，缺乏对节点表示如何演化的显式建模，导致在分布偏移下表现脆弱。

Method: KAIROS在动态图对比学习循环中嵌入可微Koopman算子，在学习到的嵌入空间中对时序演化进行线性化。采用双视图编码器，将原始节点特征与图扩散结构视图配对，并在多个时间窗口上以多粒度对比目标优化。异常检测利用Koopman预测残差、时序不一致性与局部邻域偏差来区分异常行为。

Result: 在九个动态图基准上评估，KAIROS在全部九个数据集上均取得最先进的异常检测结果，相较先前工作最高提升23.15个ROC-AUC点，同时在无监督节点分类上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，显式的动态建模为时序图表示学习提供了一种可扩展且有效的归纳偏置。

Abstract: Real-world interaction networks are inherently dynamic: edges form and dissolve as node behavior shifts over time. Most snapshot-based contrastive methods encode temporal dependencies implicitly in encoder weights, without an explicit model of how node representations evolve, making them brittle under distribution shifts. We propose KAIROS (Koopman-Aligned Invariant Representations for Open Dynamic Systems), a self-supervised framework that embeds a differentiable Koopman operator within a dynamic graph contrastive learning loop to linearize temporal evolution in the learned embedding space. A dual-view encoder pairs raw node features with a graph-diffused structural view and is optimized with multi-granularity contrastive objectives across temporal windows. For anomaly detection, KAIROS uses the Koopman prediction residual together with temporal inconsistency and local neighborhood deviation to separate irregular behavior from predictable graph evolution. Evaluated on nine dynamic graph benchmarks, KAIROS achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection results on all nine datasets, with gains of up to 23.15 ROC-AUC points over prior work, while remaining competitive for unsupervised node classification. These results show that explicit dynamics modeling provides a scalable and effective inductive bias for temporal graph representation learning.

</details>


### [420] [Temporal Geometry of Deep Networks: Hyperbolic Representations of Training Dynamics for Intrinsic Explainability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03000)
*Ambarish Moharil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种几何与时序图元学习框架，用庞加莱双曲空间对MLP训练过程中的动态参数图进行表征，揭示网络的自组织与演化几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多层感知机（MLP）的内在可解释性仍是难题，尤其在需要动态再训练的优化环境中。既有基于测度的可解释性方法通常只分析单个训练检查点，忽略了训练轨迹本身所携带的信息；该论文认为神经网络不仅在权重中编码信息，也在训练轨迹中编码信息，因此需要一种能捕捉权重拓扑几何演化与自组织过程的表示方法。

Method: 作者构建时序"参数图"——对MLP优化/训练过程的T个时间步进行快照。借鉴复杂网络可嵌入隐藏度量空间（距离对应连接可能性）的思想，提出几何与时序图元学习框架，将时序参数图嵌入庞加莱双曲模型球中。模型在快照内神经元置换下保持等变性、在过去快照置换下保持不变性，从而保持功能等价性并恢复网络潜在演化几何。

Result: 在回归与分类任务上，针对已训练MLP的实验显示该元网络具有很强的元学习性能，并伴随得到双曲时序表示，能够揭示网络结构在特定训练环境下如何随时间涌现。

Conclusion: 该工作通过双曲几何与时序图表示，为理解MLP训练动态与自组织提供了新的可解释性视角，将分析从单一检查点扩展到训练轨迹的整体演化。

Abstract: Intrinsic explainability remains a challenging problem, particularly in contexts where multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) require dynamic re-training within an optimization environment. This paper investigates how MLPs and their training dynamics can be represented and studied in non-Euclidean spaces; our representation features the Poincaré model of hyperbolic geometry. We aim to capture the geometric evolution of their weighted topology and self-organization over time. Instead of restricting the analysis to single checkpoints---as per established measure-based explainability methods---we construct temporal \textit{parameter graphs}, i.e., snapshots over time $T$ steps of the optimization/training process for MLPs. This reflects the view that neural networks encode information not only in their weights but also in the trajectory traced during training. Drawing on the idea that many complex networks admit embeddings in hidden metric spaces where distances correspond to connection likelihood, we present a geometric and temporal graph-based metalearning framework for obtaining dynamic hyperbolic representations of the underlying neural parameter graphs. Our model embeds temporal parameter graphs in the Poincaré model ball, and learns from them while maintaining equivariance to within-snapshot neuron permutations and invariance to permutations of past snapshots. In doing so, the approach preserves functional equivalence over time and recovers the latent evolving geometry of the network. Experiments on regression and classification tasks with trained MLPs show strong meta-network performance, accompanied by hyperbolic temporal representations. This reveals how the network structure emerges over time under specific training environments, thus providing insights into the network's self-organization.

</details>


### [421] [Neural Data Needs Semantic Tokenization: Behavioral Events as Boundaries of Session-Transferable Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03001)
*Sangyoon Bae,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TWS（Tokenization with States），以群体活动几何作为跨会话共享的 token 单元，取代神经元/会话嵌入，实现神经电生理数据的跨会话、跨物种泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞外电生理每次记录到的神经元集合都不同，现有神经基础模型将每个神经元和每个会话嵌入为 token，导致新会话成为未见输入而无法泛化；因此需要一个所有会话共享、且携带行为信息的 tokenization 单元。

Method: 以群体活动为单元：其演化位于跨神经元更替、跨个体对齐后持续存在的低维流形上；该流形在刺激起始、运动起始等任务事件处发生状态切换。TWS 在每试次按这些事件切分，将每个 regime 内的群体状态转换为群体几何 token，完全不使用神经元或会话嵌入。

Result: 在留出的 IBL 会话上，TWS 即使在无目标信息的 regime 边界也能解码运动，而基于单神经元的预训练基础模型仅达随机水平；仅用小鼠训练并冻结后，TWS 通过线性探针即可迁移到猕猴与 Utah array。在到达方向任务上取得 Matthews 相关 0.23（仅事件时间为 0.01）。

Conclusion: 跨会话泛化中，token 的设计比其上所接模型更关键；群体状态几何是一种可迁移的、行为相关的神经 tokenization 方案。

Abstract: Extracellular electrophysiology records a different set of neurons in every session. Neural foundation models embed each neuron and each session into their tokens, so every new session is an input they have never seen, and they fail to generalize to it. A tokenizer for new sessions needs a unit that every session shares and that carries behavior. Population activity offers such a unit. It evolves on a low-dimensional manifold that persists across neuronal turnover and across animals once sessions are aligned. This manifold changes regime at task events such as stimulus onset and movement onset. Within each regime the population occupies a state, the part of the manifold it spans between two events, and each state carries its own behavioral meaning. We propose Tokenization with States (TWS), which segments each trial, one repetition of the task, at these events and converts every state into tokens of population geometry, with no neuron or session embedding. On held-out International Brain Laboratory (IBL) sessions, TWS decodes movement even from regime boundaries that carry no information about the target, while a per-neuron foundation model pretrained on those sessions decodes at chance. Frozen after training on mice alone, TWS transfers to macaques and Utah arrays with only a linear probe. On reach direction, a target that its boundaries do not define, it achieves a Matthews correlation of 0.23, where the event time alone achieves $0.01$. For cross-session generalization, the token matters more than the model on top.

</details>


### [422] [AvoKV-E: Payload-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Long Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03007)
*Han Yu,Wenhui Zhu,Xiwen Chen,Zhipeng Wang,Hejian Sang,Han Shi,Menglin Zhou,Xuanzhao Dong,Minzhou Huang,Rui Cai,Hao Wang,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练KV缓存淘汰策略AvoKV-E，通过延迟新生成状态的淘汰资格并对合格条目按读取压力、键冗余与值载荷潜力排序，在长推理任务中以更紧缓存预算匹配或超越多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长输出推理使KV缓存瓶颈从固定提示转向生成轨迹。现有推理缓存淘汰方法多将缓存条目视为"路由对象"，只估计旧键是否还会被读取或复现，忽略了两个效应：低注意力条目可能携带大值载荷，删除会改变未来预测；新生成状态可能在后续查询读取前就被误判为过时。

Method: AvoKV-E是一种免训练淘汰策略：首先对近期状态延迟其可淘汰资格，然后对合格条目结合候选归一化读取压力、键冗余度和值载荷潜力进行排序打分，从而决定淘汰对象。

Result: 在不同模型和数据集上的实证评估显示，AvoKV-E在相同活动KV预算下匹配或超越冗余感知、复现驱动和思维自适应等淘汰基线，且在缓存最紧张的情形下增益最大。组件与反事实分析进一步将增益归因于延迟观察、载荷感知打分、冗余与尺度稳健归一化。

Conclusion: 长推理KV淘汰不应只保留可能被读取的键，还应保留支撑推理轨迹的值载荷。

Abstract: Long-output reasoning shifts the KV-cache bottleneck from the fixed prompt to the generated trace. Existing reasoning-cache eviction methods largely treat cached entries as routing objects, estimating whether an old key will still be read, will recur, or can be replaced. This routing-only view overlooks two effects: low-attention entries can carry large value payloads whose removal changes future predictions, and newly generated states can appear stale before later queries have had a chance to read them. We introduce AvoKV-E, a training-free eviction policy that first delays eligibility for recent states and then ranks eligible entries using candidate-normalized read pressure, key redundancy, and value-payload potential. According to empirical evaluation across different models and datasets, AvoKV-E matches or exceeds redundancy-aware, recurrence-based, and thought-adaptive eviction baselines at matched active-KV budgets, with its largest gains in the tightest-cache regime. Component and counterfactual analyses further connect these gains to delayed observation, payload-aware scoring, redundancy, and scale-robust normalization. Together, the results show that long-reasoning KV eviction should preserve not only keys that are likely to be read, but also the value payloads that sustain the reasoning trajectory.

</details>


### [423] [Signal Simplification Is Not Predictive Simplification: Diagnosing Residual Neural Forecasting in Short-Horizon Volatility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03019)
*Bingqi Lian,Linfeng Cheng,Mei Lu,Jerry Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了混合统计-神经管道中“统计首阶段成功会留下更干净、更易学习的残差”的假设，发现残差虽然方差大幅降低且几乎无自相关，但残差LSTM增强反而使预测误差变大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合统计-神经管道常假定统计首阶段成功后会留下更干净、更可学习的残差目标。作者在短期波动率预测场景中检验这一假设，探究统计残差简化是否真能转化为下游神经网络的有效预条件。

Method: 采用信号-预测-系统诊断框架，在五只流动性较好的美国资产上进行短期波动率预测。构建波动率对齐的HAR式模型并与AR、MA、ARIMA对比；在扩展训练窗口内考察标准化前的拟合残差过程（用于构造残差LSTM序列）的方差与滞后1自相关；独立地通过滚动伪样本外HAR误差分析；并对比纯LSTM、残差LSTM增强及残差混合模型的MSE与运行时间。

Result: 波动率对齐的HAR式模型优于AR、MA、ARIMA。残差过程方差比对应目标低约82%，滞后1自相关接近零；滚动伪样本外HAR误差方差降低约74%，滞后1依赖同样很弱。然而残差LSTM增强反而使平均MSE从0.3049升至0.3594，且每只资产都恶化。纯LSTM取得最低的伪样本外MSE 0.2649，残差混合模型需显著更多端到端运行时间却未提升精度。

Conclusion: 作者将这一现象称为“预测器-预条件器不对称”：首阶段预测成功与统计残差简化，并不必然转化为有用的下游神经预条件，提示混合管道中统计阶段成功不能作为神经阶段收益的可靠指标。

Abstract: Hybrid statistical-neural pipelines often assume that a successful statistical first stage leaves a cleaner and more learnable residual target. We examine that assumption in short-horizon volatility forecasting through a signal-forecast-system diagnostic framework. Across five liquid U.S. assets, a volatility-aligned HAR-style model outperforms AR, MA, and ARIMA. Within expanding training windows, the pre-standardization fitted residual process used to construct residual-LSTM sequences has about 82% lower variance than the corresponding target and near-zero lag-1 autocorrelation; independently, rolling pseudo-out-of-sample HAR errors show about 74% variance reduction and similarly weak lag-1 dependence. Residual-only LSTM augmentation nevertheless raises mean squared error from 0.3049 to 0.3594 on average, with deterioration on every asset. Pure LSTM records the lowest selected pseudo-out-of-sample MSE, 0.2649, while the residual hybrid requires substantially more end-to-end runtime without improving accuracy. We describe this pattern as forecaster-preconditioner asymmetry: first-stage forecasting success and statistical residual simplification need not translate into useful downstream neural preconditioning.

</details>


### [424] [Balancing Multimodal Learning via Functional Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03035)
*Zhongjing Gu,Fengqiang Wan,Yiming Cui,Yufa Feng,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FGMO，用函数空间进度信号评估各模态优化进度并协调优化，缓解多模态学习的模态失衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态学习常存在模态失衡，联合优化被单一模态主导。现有方法多基于预测不确定性或优化统计的分数差异来估计失衡，但不同模态的预测不确定性和学习动态各异，直接比较这些分数会把内在的模态差异误判为进度差距，导致失衡估计有偏。

Method: FGMO包含两个组件：Functional Progress Estimation（FPE）测量各模态更新引起的函数空间响应，并以损失对齐的单模态参考进行校准，得到可比较的进度信号；Functional Response Control（FRC）基于该信号重新分配模态级函数空间预算，并通过张量级学习率调整实现目标响应。

Result: 理论分析建立了FRC在有界控制器状态失配下的一步目标收缩性质；大量实验在多个多模态基准上验证了FGMO的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过函数空间进度信号协调模态优化，FGMO能更准确地刻画模态优化进度，有效缓解模态失衡，并在多模态基准上取得良好表现。

Abstract: Multimodal learning often suffers from modality imbalance, where the joint optimization process is dominated by a single modality. Existing methods typically estimate modality imbalance from score disparities derived from prediction uncertainty or optimization statistics. However, due to distinct prediction uncertainty and learning dynamics across modalities, direct comparison of such scores may misinterpret intrinsic modality differences as progress gaps, leading to biased imbalance estimation. In this paper, we propose Function-Space Guided Multimodal Optimization (FGMO), which leverages a function-space progress signal to assess modality-wise optimization progress and coordinate optimization across modalities to alleviate modality imbalance. Specifically, we introduce Functional Progress Estimation (FPE) to measure each modality's update-induced function-space response and calibrate it against a loss-aligned unimodal reference, producing a comparable progress signal. Based on this signal, Functional Response Control (FRC) redistributes modality-level function-space budgets and realizes the target responses through tensor-wise learning-rate adjustment. Theoretical analysis establishes a one-step target-contraction property of FRC under bounded controller-state mismatch, and extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FGMO across multiple multimodal benchmarks.

</details>


### [425] [RIPPLE in Still Water: Zero-Shot Clustering in Federated Learning with Wavelet Scattering Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03054)
*Alessandro Licciardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RIPPLE将聚类联邦学习的簇分配完全离线化：基于客户端本地数据的方差加权主成分原型（经小波散射变换嵌入、由高斯混合VAE解码）在联邦开始前于服务端合成数据上训练完成，每轮通信与FedAvg相同，训练外客户端单次前向即可获个性化模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类联邦学习可缓解非IID数据下的客户端漂移，但现有方法在训练循环内通过梯度相似度、损失评估或EM更新发现簇结构，带来通信开销增加、梯度暴露于反演攻击、且无法为未参与训练的客户端分配簇等问题。

Method: 离线簇分配：对每个客户端本地数据构建方差加权主成分原型，用小波散射变换嵌入，并由高斯混合VAE在联邦前于服务端合成客户端群体上训练解码；推理时新客户端仅需一次前向传播，无需梯度计算、模型评估或额外通信轮次。

Result: 理论上证明代理聚类目标与oracle之间的差距由一个可计算量上有界，该量随客户端样本量衰减且与联邦时长无关；每簇收敛率匹配非凸光滑目标的极小极大最优率。在五个涵盖受控与真实异质性的基准上，RIPPLE一致优于所有基线，且在最优真实分区上优势更大。

Conclusion: RIPPLE以离线谱表征驱动的簇分配替代训练内聚类，在保持FedAvg通信成本的同时支持训练外客户端单次前向个性化，并具备有界近似与最优收敛保证，实验表现稳定优越。

Abstract: Clustered Federated Learning (FL) partitions a client population into groups of similar local distributions and trains one specialized model per cluster, mitigating client drift that degrades single-model methods under non-IID data. Prior methods discover cluster structure inside the training loop through gradient similarity, loss evaluation, or EM-style updates, thus increasing communication overhead, exposing gradients to inversion attacks, and providing no mechanism to assign clients absent from training. We propose RIPPLE, a clustered FL framework in which cluster assignment is computed entirely offline from a spectral characterization of each client's local data: a variance-weighted principal-component prototype embedded via the Wavelet Scattering Transform and decoded by a Gaussian Mixture VAE trained server-side on synthetic client populations before federation begins. Per-round communication cost matches FedAvg exactly, and a client absent from training obtains a personalized model from a single forward pass, without gradient computation, model evaluation, or extra communication round. We prove that the gap between RIPPLE's surrogate clustered objective and the oracle is bounded by a computable quantity decaying with client sample size and independent of federation duration; per-cluster convergence matches the minimax-optimal rate for non-convex smooth objectives. Across five benchmarks spanning controlled and realistic heterogeneity, RIPPLE consistently outperforms all baselines, with margins growing on the most realistic partitions.

</details>


### [426] [When Does Synthetic Relational Data Teach Models to Use Relations? Tracing Predictive Structure from Pretraining Data to Model Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03057)
*Shivam Dubey,Mohamed Bouadi,Nassim Bouarour,Varun Kulkarni,Aditya Tanna,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以数据归因视角研究合成数据库预训练数据中的哪一属性诱导关系计算，发现当跨表信息对掩码单元预测任务具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会涌现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系基础模型日益依赖合成数据库预训练，但下游基准无法解释为何某一合成语料优于另一语料。强性能可能仅来自真实的行级统计，而模型从未真正学会利用关系结构。因此需要定位合成预训练数据中诱发关系计算的属性。

Method: 将问题建模为数据归因问题。使用相同架构、初始化、目标和算力预算训练的四个 Relational Transformer 检查点，分别对应四种关系数据生成器产出的语料。追踪数据的可测属性到学习到的计算及下游行为的联系；提出假设：当跨表信息对掩码单元预训练目标具有预测必要性时，关系机制才会涌现。并通过随机初始化对照、破坏链接比例的单调增长实验以及跨表通路的定位进行验证，最后在下游推理时干预该机制。

Result: RelDiff 从外键链接的父表中获得远高于其他生成器的预测增益，其对应模型对未见数据库上的外键干预表现出独有的敏感性。该依赖性在随机初始化对照下依然成立，并随损坏链接比例单调增长，且定位于一条串行的跨表通路。

Conclusion: 在下游推理中破坏同一机制会消除 RelDiff 在关系任务上的优势，而对结构不敏感的模型几乎无影响。研究将合成训练数据的某一属性与学习到的机制联系起来，并通过干预关联到下游行为。

Abstract: Relational foundation models are increasingly pretrained on synthetic databases, yet downstream benchmarks reveal little about why one synthetic corpus produces a better model than another. In particular, strong performance may arise from realistic row-level statistics without the model ever learning to use relational structure. We study this as a data-attribution problem: which property of synthetic pretraining data induces relational computation? Using four Relational Transformer checkpoints trained with the same architecture, initialization, objective, and compute budget on corpora produced by four relational data generators, we trace a measurable property of the data to learned computation and downstream behavior. We hypothesize that relational mechanisms emerge when cross-table information is predictively necessary for the masked-cell pretraining objective. RelDiff exhibits by far the largest predictive gain from foreign-key-linked parents, and its corresponding model is uniquely sensitive to foreign-key interventions on unseen databases.
